competencies.title: Visual Identity Engineering
competencies.description: Brand design focused on longevity, scalability, and technical rigor. Building perennial visual assets for institutions that demand authority.

competencies.title: Institutional Design Systems
competencies.description: Visual identity management for government agencies and large corporations. Creation of manuals, guidelines, and design systems for multi-platform application.

competencies.title: Architectural Signage & Wayfinding
competencies.description: Facade projections (ACM), high-fidelity physical signage, fleet branding, and environmental design. Integration of graphic design into architectural space.
